title: Generative AI for Django Web Application Developers
overview: This course explores how Generative AI can be integrated into Django-based web applications, enhancing functionality with AI-driven content generation, chatbots, recommendations, search optimization, code automation, and intelligent analytics.
Participants will learn how to incorporate AI models (GPT, Stable Diffusion, Llama, and OpenAI APIs) into Django applications, automate development tasks, and optimize user experiences using AI.

By the end of the course, learners will be able to build AI-powered Django applications that include personalized user experiences, automated content generation, intelligent search, and predictive analytics.
audience: Django Web Developers who want to integrate AI into their applications.
Full-Stack Developers building AI-enhanced web applications.
Backend Engineers looking to implement AI-powered APIs and automation.
Tech Leads & Software Architects interested in AI-driven web development strategies.
AI Enthusiasts & Data Scientists who want to integrate AI models with Django.
methodology: The course follows a hands-on and project-based approach, including:
Instructor-led sessions – Concept explanations with practical demonstrations.
Live coding & hands-on labs – Implementing AI features in Django projects.
Practical assignments & case studies – Solving real-world Django AI use cases.
Capstone project – Developing a fully functional AI-powered Django web application.
competencies: By completing this course, participants will gain expertise in:
Integrating AI models (GPT, Stable Diffusion, Hugging Face) into Django.
Enhancing search and analytics using AI.
Automating web development tasks with AI-generated code.
Deploying AI-powered Django applications in cloud environments.
objectivesIntro: Upon completing the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Implement AI-powered content generation in Django applications.
Build AI-enhanced chatbots and recommendation engines.
Use AI for intelligent search and personalized experiences.
Automate Django code generation and debugging with AI.
Deploy AI-driven analytics and predictive insights.
Optimize AI-powered Django applications for scalability and security.

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Generative AI for Django

items.text: Overview of Generative AI and its applications in web development.
Understanding AI-powered automation in Django.
Exploring Open-AI API, Hugging Face, Lang-Chain, and Stable Diffusion.
Hands-on: Setting up an AI-ready Django development environment.

outline.title: Module 2: AI-Powered Content Generation in Django

items.text: Using LLMs (Large Language Models) to generate blog posts, summaries, and reports.
Automating SEO-friendly content generation for Django applications.
AI-driven email generation and response automation.
Hands-on: Building an AI-powered content generation feature in Django.
Integrating AI chatbots using OpenAI API in Django applications.
Building an AI-driven customer support bot with Django REST API.
AI-powered sentiment analysis for chatbot responses.
Hands-on: Creating an AI chatbot with Django and GPT API.
Implementing AI-based product & content recommendations.
Using collaborative & content-based filtering in Django applications.
Enhancing user engagement with personalized AI-driven recommendations.
Hands-on: Developing a Django-based AI recommendation engine.

outline.title: Module 5: AI for Intelligent Search & Auto-Completion

items.text: Enhancing search functionality using AI-powered semantic search.
Implementing natural language search in Django applications.
AI-driven auto-suggestions and autocomplete for search bars.
Hands-on: Building an AI-powered intelligent search feature in Django.

outline.title: Module 6: Automating Django Code Generation with AI

items.text: Using AI to generate Django models, serializers, and API endpoints.
AI-powered code refactoring and debugging in Django projects.
Automating unit tests and documentation with AI.
Hands-on: Using AI to optimize Django development workflows.

outline.title: Module 7: AI for Predictive Analytics & Data Insights

items.text: Implementing AI-powered data visualization & analytics dashboards.
Using AI for user behavior prediction & business insights.
AI-driven predictive analytics for user engagement & retention.
Hands-on: Developing a predictive analytics dashboard in Django.

outline.title: Module 8: AI-Powered Image & Video Generation in Django

items.text: Integrating Stable Diffusion for AI-generated images.
AI-powered profile picture & banner generation.
Implementing video summarization & AI-generated thumbnails.
Hands-on: Adding AI-generated image features to a Django application.
Best practices for deploying AI-powered Django applications.
Optimizing Django applications for performance & scalability.
Securing AI-powered features against misuse & vulnerabilities.
Hands-on: Deploying an AI-enhanced Django project to cloud platforms.

outline.title: Module 10: Capstone Project – AI-Powered Django Web Application

items.text: Final project: Building & deploying a Django web application with AI-powered features.
Peer review and evaluation of AI integrations in Django projects.
Certification and career guidance in AI-enhanced web development.

extra.title: Prerequisites
items: Basic knowledge of APIs and databases.
Understanding of Machine Learning & AI concepts (helpful but optional).
